rules.title: Bound the loop
rules.text: Cap iterations, tokens and wall-clock time for every agent loop.

rules.title: Human approval for risky steps
rules.text: Require human approval before irreversible or high-impact actions.

rules.title: Trace every step
rules.text: Log each model call and tool call with inputs, outputs and timing for debugging.

rules.title: Keep context small
rules.text: Summarize or drop stale context and pass only what the next step needs.

rules.title: Sandbox execution
rules.text: Run generated code and shell commands in a sandbox with restricted network and filesystem access.

rules.title: Test end-to-end tasks
rules.text: Evaluate agents on whole tasks with deterministic checkers, not only single prompts.
